title: Runoff set for Laredo College Board of Trustees Position 9 on Dec. 12
excerpt: Laredo College will hold a runoff election Dec. 12 for Position 9 on its Board of Trustees after no candidate won a majority in the Nov. 3 general election, the college announced.
content:
Laredo College will hold a runoff election on Saturday, Dec. 12, 2026, for Position 9 on the Laredo College District Board of Trustees, after no candidate received a majority of the votes cast in the Nov. 3 general election, the college announced.

Early voting for the runoff is scheduled from Monday, Nov. 30, through Tuesday, Dec. 8, according to Laredo College.

Under Texas Education Code Section 130.082(g), a candidate must receive a majority of the votes cast to be declared elected. If no candidate reaches a majority, the two candidates with the highest number of votes advance to a runoff. The same requirement is reflected in Laredo College Board Policy BBBB, which states that if no candidate receives a majority, the two candidates with the highest vote totals run against each other, and the runoff is held on a Saturday designated by the secretary of state.

Laredo College President Dr. Minita Ramírez thanked the community for its strong participation in the election and encouraged voters to return to the polls for the runoff.

"We are incredibly grateful to the voters who came out in historic numbers to make their voices heard in this election," Dr. Ramírez said, according to the college. "We ask our community to once again take part in this important process during the runoff election."

"We thank our community for taking part in this election and every candidate who answered the call to serve," LC Board President Esteban Rangel added. "We encourage voters to once again make their voices heard in the runoff election."

The runoff will determine who serves Position 9 on the Board of Trustees. Additional information about the runoff is available on Laredo College's Elections website at go.laredo.edu/elections.

Source: Laredo College, November 9, 2026.
